biggest_catch: The friend must establish recurring direct deposit(s) totaling at least $500 within 90 days of account opening for the checking track, and rewards can take up to 120 days from account opening to arrive - the referrer earns nothing until the friend completes the full qualification cycle.
catches: Friend must be a new Climb member (not a member within the previous year) who joins and opens a checking account.
Checking track: friend must establish recurring direct deposit(s) totaling at least $500 posting within 90 days of account opening.
Mortgage track: friend must join and close a first mortgage within 90 days of account opening.
The online referral form must be submitted at initial account opening - referrals submitted after account opening do not qualify.
Reward funds are deposited up to 120 days from account opening, once qualifications are met.
Both members must own at least one share, be current on all credit obligations, and not have caused the credit union an outstanding loss.
The cash bonus is considered interest and is subject to IRS and other tax reporting.
Must be at least 18 years of age; Climb Credit Union employees are not eligible.

steps: Fill out the Climb member referral form to register and receive your unique referral code.
Invite friends via social media or email with your referral link.
Friend registers and joins Climb via your link, submitting the referral form at initial account opening.
Friend opens a checking account and establishes recurring direct deposit(s) totaling at least $500 posting within 90 days (or closes a first mortgage within 90 days for the mortgage track).
timing: Cash reward deposited into both members' share accounts once qualifications are met, up to 120 days from account opening.
